name: Fantasy & Magic Con
blurb: A Warsaw pop-culture weekend of fantasy and sci-fi media guests, with many film, TV and video-game voice actors plus cosplay contests.

editions.evidence: Homepage banner: 'FANTASY & MAGIC CON WILL RETURN AUGUST 6-8 2027!'; guest page heading 'FMC 2027 Guests'; confirmed by the con's own X post: 'Join @Mark_Meer and other Mass Effect cast members on August 6-8 2027 in Warsaw, Poland for the second edition of Fantasy & Magic Con'.

notes: The .eu homepage is the current site (uploads still sometimes resolve to the legacy fantasymagiccon.pl domain). 2027 is the con's second edition; the first was held in July 2026 at Tor Służewiec, Warsaw. One homepage news headline misnames it 'Fantasy & Magic Con 2026 guest lineup' when adding Luke Roberts/Salóme Gunnarsdóttir, but the guest page itself is titled 'FMC 2027 Guests' and the countdown banner, the guest page heading and the con's own social post all agree on August 6-8, 2027 — treated the headline's '2026' as a copy error. The 2027 venue has not been announced yet (last used Tor Służewiec, Puławska 266, Warsaw, for the 2026 edition). Picked 15 named guests plus 5 stage hosts (André Peña, Troy Beaumont, Krzysztof Ruszkowski, Wiktor Lewandowski, Antoni Strojny) who have their own photo cards under 'Hosts of FMC 2027' with Twitch/YouTube/Instagram/Facebook icons, categorised as creator; skipped candidate #16 ('Coming Soon') and #20 ('To be announced') as unannounced slots, and #0 as the nav logo. Verify pass (2026-10-05): current -- the page's own meta description reads 'FMC 2027 Guests' and several guest photos are filenamed with '-2027' (DC-2027.png, Nika-2027.png, Salome-2027.png); its '2026' hits are only WordPress upload-folder paths (/uploads/2026/08/, /uploads/2026/10/), not an edition year, so the lineup stands.
